Recall groups.
Two cells have only notes 4 and 7, so 4 and 7 go only in these two cells and are removed from the other cells of this line.

When 2 digits fill 2 cells like this,
it is called a locked set (a group).

A set with one more digit than cells, like this,
is called an almost locked set (ALS).

If 9 dropped out of these three cells,

So 2, 4, 7 are removed
from the other cells of this line.

If 2 drops out, 4, 7, 9 become a locked set,
and 4, 7, 9 are removed from the other cells.
